items.caption: Modern vector rendering of 忍 in a seal-script style. Traditional 認 is analyzed as 言 plus sound-bearing 忍; this image shows the component, not an early form of 認.
items.alt: Black seal-style 忍 glyph on a white background, with a complex upper shape above a heart-like lower form.
items.selection_reason: Helps illustrate the 忍 component in the traditional analysis of 認 while making clear that it does not document 認’s historical form.

items.caption: Modern vector rendering of 言 in a seal-script style. Traditional 認 is analyzed with 言 as its speech-related component; this image shows the component, not an early form of 認.
items.alt: Black seal-style 言 glyph on a white background, with stacked horizontal strokes above a lower enclosing shape.
items.selection_reason: Helps illustrate the speech-related 言 component in the traditional analysis without implying this is an attested form of 認.

limitations.text: These modern component renderings show 言 and 忍, not 認 itself. 認 is reported absent from Shuowen, and no dated early inscriptional form of the character is established here.
